title: Barcelona dress up tour
text: What a fantastic experience! Val and Nati were incredibly welcoming, friendly, and easy to communicate with in English. They made me feel comfortable and confident, keeping things fun with plenty of laughs and compliments throughout the shoot. There were three beautiful dresses to choose from (pink, wine red, and teal). I chose pink! The dress was comfortable and adjustable for different body types. title: A unique and beautiful memory in Barcelona
text: I've always wanted to do a flying dress photoshoot and when I saw this was available in Barcelona, I signed up through Marriott (to earn points). Leading up to the photoshoot, I already had great online communication about picking my pink flying dress (favorite color) and confirming the 8 am start time (which was early for me but needed to beat the crowds).
